suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as rare infection complication. Require documented Nocardia infection and separately diagnosed Nocardia infective endocarditis. Rare systematic review of reported cases; do not infer endocarditis from nocardiosis alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Nocardiosis and Pericarditis / Endocarditis / Myocarditis
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
